ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized in small clusters and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white geometric clusters at the extreme distal tips. Small, scattered white circular focal spots (mottling) distributed across the central and lower portions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence angle of approximately 45-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe exhibits relatively rhythmic, low-amplitude rounded serrations. The right lobe displays a significant, deep V-shaped macro-indentation approximately one-third the distance from the median notch, followed by irregular, jagged high-frequency peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature sweeping from the median notch outward and upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, white high-contrast pixels located at the far-left and far-right tips, consistent with localized surface colonization. Scattered individual white circular spots visible across the dark field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple white, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (scratch patterns) visible on the lower interior portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, deep V-shaped indentation or notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe, representing a significant disruption of the expected continuous geometric curve.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips, creating a highly irregular and high-contrast texture at the fluke boundaries.
